title: Stand up the audit-observation tracking loop with 3-month closure and IT Committee escalation
description: Write and adopt a procedure in the ISMS document repository covering four steps. (1) Within 5 working days of receiving each cyber audit or VAPT report, record every observation as a finding in company-profile/example-co/soc/main.jsonl through refresh-soc / soc-ledger-keeper, with slaBasis copied from sla-table.json (sebi-cscrf-2024 Sec-4.4 audit-cadence 90 days for cyber audit observations; Sec-4.3 vapt-cadence 90 days for VAPT observations), a named owner and slaDueAt = report submission + 90 days. (2) Each such finding is linked to an impl-change-management initiative. (3) Observations still open after 3 months go to the IT Committee for approval and must close before the next audit, per CSCRF 4.4.4-4.4.5. (4) The follow-on audit is scheduled within 5 months of report submission. Apply the procedure retrospectively to the open observations identified in Task 1. Technical observations are assigned to the CTO (cto@example-co.invalid) as remediation owner.
acceptanceCriteria: The approved procedure document exists in the ISMS repository with a version, approval date and IT Committee minutes reference, and covers ledger recording, 90-day closure, IT Committee escalation and a follow-on audit within 5 months.

For every open observation listed in Task 1, the latest-state ledger view (soc-ledger skill section 3 command, filtered to kind finding) shows a finding with slaBasis.topic audit-cadence or vapt-cadence, a non-empty initiativeId and a slaDueAt no later than report submission + 90 days.
An escalation register lists every observation open for more than 3 months, with the IT Committee approval reference, or states that there are none.

verificationMethod.description: The reviewer runs the soc-ledger latest-state command on company-profile/example-co/soc/main.jsonl filtered to findings and cross-checks it against the Task 1 observation list and the procedure document. Expected result: a one-to-one match between report observations and ledger findings, each with an initiativeId and a 90-day slaBasis, plus an escalation register entry for any finding past 90 days.

rootCause.description: There is no defined workflow that turns audit and VAPT observations into owned, dated, tracked remediation items, so closure within the CSCRF 3-month window cannot be demonstrated.
